40 cmm of a mixture of return air and outdoor air enters a cooling coil of an air 13   
conditioning system at 32°C DBT and l 9°C WBT. The effective surface temperature of   
the coil is 5°C. The surface area of the cooling coil provides 14 kW of <sub>refrigerating</sub>   
effect. Determine the dry bulb and wet bulb temperatures of the air <sub>leaving</sub> the <sub>cooling</sub>   
coil and the bypass factor.
